{{Quote|Mazi can talk anyone into anything. Dad was easy. Like always.|[[Lan (Human)|Lan]] on his father|<ref name="Hostage" />}}
This '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]''' was the father of [[Lan (Human)|Lan]] and resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The day before Alderaan's [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], Lan and his friends, [[Mazi]] and [[Jez (Human)|Jez]], went to [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]] to watch a [[Smashball/Legends|smashball]] tournament. Despite Lan's young age, his father was easily convinced by Mazi to allow them to go. Lan's father later died along with his [[Lan's mother|wife]] when Alderaan was destroyed.<ref name="Hostage" />
